The evening shift flagged an idea about training days, and thanks for your comments we are sorry that your journey with Aurelia Skyways and the Companion Animal Travel Desk left you feeling that your companion's care and your own concerns were not handled with the attention you expected. You described a disruption in the service path for your animal, a lack of clear guidance from staff, and an experience that made the travel process feel unsafe and poorly managed.

As a safety reviewer, I have considered the account with care. Our team is expected to coordinate support from booking through pickup, and that standard includes careful communication, prompt attention to hazards, and respectful treatment at every stage. When a passenger reports confusion, delay, or discomfort related to an animal's handling, we treat that as a service and safety concern, not a routine complaint. The goal is to reduce stress for both the traveler and the animal, and to prevent repeat issues through review, coaching, and stronger checks.

We are also reviewing whether the welcome team and the on-ground staff gave complete instructions and whether the handoff points were managed in a way that protected both welfare and confidence. If your complaint includes an injury report or a cabin temperature concern, the applicable claim guidance remains available through the proper channel and is handled under our standard process. The matter will be recorded for corrective follow-up, and the involved teams may be asked to complete additional training focused on animal comfort, clear language, and escalation when conditions do not meet expectations.

Please accept our apology for the distress caused. Your report has value because it helps us identify where our safety practices and customer care must improve. We regret that your trust was shaken, and we will continue working to ensure that future travelers receive more consistent support from Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
